_meta.purpose: Propose-only pilot jurisdiction-pack matrix for the Global Protections Regulatory Benchmark. It chooses concrete curation scopes and domain lenses but contains no source-verified legal claims.
_meta.status: propose-only -- every pack cell needs dated source objects, privacy review, source-path review, and expert review before prompts, public claims, worker-facing use, or comparable scoring.

pilot_policy: Use this matrix only to plan source curation. A jurisdiction pack is not accepted until every required source-object slot has a dated public source, archive status, privacy review, source-path review, and expert review.
